title: Performance Frame
description: Check out this lightweight Minecraft modpack that’s all about boosting performance and adding some handy quality-of-life mods. Perfect for SMP and multiplayer servers, it ensures you get better FPS, smoother gameplay, and a more stable experience.
body: The modpack is centered on improving Minecraft's performance while incorporating a few useful mods that make the game smoother and easier to play. It is centered on SMP servers or multiplayer servers, helping users get better FPS while not altering the game's feel greatly. The modpack has incorporated optimization mods that help reduce lag in the game while incorporating useful features that make the game easier to play. It is a lightweight modpack that helps keep Minecraft close to vanilla while improving performance.
